answer: When k identities equivocate in a correlated pattern, the protocol links their evidence and applies penalties across the k(k−1)/2 identity pairs, making the liability O(k²), not k independent fines. Bonded escrows make that liability collectible; asymmetric depreciation compounds the loss, so a detected sybil swarm faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss. An ivory credential or an oasis of apparently separate keys cannot conceal a shared plume of coordinated behavior.
